title: Self Love Stickers-Motivational Stickers
author: Happy Printables Club
description:
Self Love Stickers-Motivational Stickers Bundle PNG
These cute and awesome stickers are going to be your perfect source of Self Love for you !!
Add these motivational and inspirational stickers in your notebooks, journals or planners and bring back your confidence and charm.
You can also use these stickers in your planners, notebook covers, journals, cards, laptop, tumblers, tote bags and much more.
WHAT DO YOU GET
You get a ZIP file folder which includes-
11 PNG WITH TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND
Each design measures 3 inches at its widest point, 300 DPI.
***** THIS LISTING IS FOR A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD ONLY – NO PHYSICAL PRODUCTS WILL BE SHIPPED TO YOU **
PLEASE NOTE:
Depending on your computer monitor and resolution, colors may appear different from the actual download. Therefore there may be some variance between the way colors look on your screen compare to the actual print.
